## Handout 10 — The Mark of Mars

<div class="handout-label">Distribute at session end, after final resolution. Place face-up without comment. Let silence sit.</div>

<div class="mark-block">
  <div class="mark-symbol">⚔ ♂ ⚔</div>
  <div class="mark-latin">MILES PROBATUS EST</div>
  <div class="mark-translation">"The soldier has been tested."</div>
  <div class="handout-divider"></div>
  <div class="mark-text">
    You stood before him. He did not look away.<br>
    The mark does not wash off.<br>
    It does not hurt, except in the presence of cowardice.<br>
    Mars gives no gifts without weight.<br>
    This is both.
  </div>
  <div class="handout-divider"></div>
  <div class="mark-text">
    <strong style="color:#c8a84b;">Mechanical effect (if using):</strong><br>
    Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw, you may re-roll. You must use the new result. The god is watching.
  </div>
  <div class="mark-footer">Vindolanda · Year 2 of the Reign · By Divine Witness</div>
</div>

## Handout 11 — Arena Weapon Cards

<div class="handout-label">Place face-down at session start. Flip ALL cards at once when the black sand appears. Each card = one weapon available at the arena's edge. Bonus action to grab one.</div>

<div class="weapons-grid">

<div class="weapon-card">
  <div class="card-num">Card I</div>
  <div class="card-name">Gladius of Distinction</div>
  <div class="card-stats">
    +2 to attack and damage rolls<br>
    Damage: as normal gladius
  </div>
  <div class="card-property">
    <strong>Sacred Edge:</strong> Add 2d6 radiant damage on each hit.
  </div>
  <div class="card-cost">Each attack also deals 1d6 radiant to the wielder. The god's attention burns the unworthy.</div>
</div>

<div class="weapon-card">
  <div class="card-num">Card II</div>
  <div class="card-name">Pilum of the Unbroken Line</div>
  <div class="card-stats">
    Range: 60/120 ft<br>
    Damage: 2d8+4 piercing
  </div>
  <div class="card-property">
    <strong>Formation Throw:</strong> On a hit, DC 15 Str save or target is Restrained until end of their next turn.
  </div>
  <div class="card-cost">The thrower cannot move on the round they use this weapon.</div>
</div>

<div class="weapon-card">
  <div class="card-num">Card III</div>
  <div class="card-name">Scutum of Endurance</div>
  <div class="card-stats">
    +3 AC while held<br>
    (held, not worn — occupies one hand)
  </div>
  <div class="card-property">
    <strong>Last Stand:</strong> Once per fight, reduce to 1 HP instead of 0.
  </div>
  <div class="card-cost">Disadvantage on all attack rolls while carrying it.</div>
</div>

<div class="weapon-card">
  <div class="card-num">Card IV</div>
  <div class="card-name">Spear of the Veteran</div>
  <div class="card-stats">
    Versatile (1d6 / 1d8), reach 10 ft<br>
    Damage: as listed
  </div>
  <div class="card-property">
    <strong>Disciplined Strike:</strong> If the wielder did not move this turn, add +2d6 damage.
  </div>
  <div class="card-cost">If the bonus damage is used, the wielder must end their turn where they started it.</div>
</div>

<div class="weapon-card weapon-card-wide">
  <div class="card-num">Card V</div>
  <div class="card-name">War-God's Seax</div>
  <div class="card-stats">
    Finesse, 1d6+3 piercing
  </div>
  <div class="card-property">
    <strong>Precision:</strong> Ignore the target's AC bonus from armor (not shields).
  </div>
  <div class="card-cost">On a miss, the seax deals 1d4 piercing damage to the wielder's hand.</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="weapon-dm-note">
DM: These weapons return to the arena perimeter when dropped. A character who has grabbed one cannot swap to a different card mid-combat — the weapon chooses its wielder as much as the wielder chooses the weapon. Mars is watching the choices, not just the rolls.
</div>
